name: Bark and Ambrosia Beetle Benchmark
description: A fixed, versioned benchmark for detecting and identifying bark and ambrosia beetles (Coleoptera: Curculionidae: Scolytinae and Platypodinae) in specimen photographs, derived from the Bark and Ambrosia Gallery (https://barkandambrosiagallery.org/). It contains 14,491 images of 175 species, with 100,694 expert-reviewed bounding-box annotations in COCO format. Splits: training (6,096 images, 65 species), in-distribution test (620), iNaturalist field-photograph test (74), and a held-out species test (7,701 images, 110 species never seen in training), which is grouped by taxonomic distance from the training species (within genus, within tribe, outside tribe). The splits are specimen-disjoint. Annotations, splits, taxonomy and evaluation code are CC BY 4.0. Each image keeps its own Creative Commons licence, listed in image_licences.csv; most are CC BY-NC 4.0.
